Bottom of the rounded body tapers into the original short dark bronze segmented conical point, no legs or feet. Keep original left/right asymmetry and exact number/arrangement of readable wing blades. The partial gold dark-centered circle clipped at extreme left of reference is a neighboring atlas fragment, NOT part of this creature; omit it. Do not add eyes, limbs, gears, inscription or feathers made of natural plumage. Keep original wide silhouette, roughly 1.147 width for 1.0 height including halo and wings.
